United States one-dollar bill.fact: This occurred with that year's passage of the Silver Purchase Act, which led to a large increase in dollar bills backed by that metal.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: A year later, in _____, the design of the one-dollar bill was changed again
United States one-dollar bill.fact: A year later, in 1935, the design of the one-dollar bill was changed again.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The reverse was also changed to its current design, except for the absence of _____
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The reverse was also changed to its current design, except for the absence of IN GOD WE TRUST.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Special $1 _____ were issued for Hawaii in case of a Japanese invasion
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Special $1 Silver Certificates were issued for Hawaii in case of a Japanese invasion. Special Silver Certificates were also issued as payment for Allied troops in North Africa about to begin their assault into Europe, being distinguishable from regular Silver Certificates by their yellow seals; unlike the Hawaii overprint series, the remainder of the design was left unchanged.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The next change came in _____ when the $1 bill became the first piece of paper U.S
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The next change came in 1957 when the $1 bill became the first piece of paper U.S. Thus all series 1957 and later notes include the motto.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Thus all series _____ and later notes include the motto
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The next change came in 1957 when the $1 bill became the first piece of paper U.S. Thus all series 1957 and later notes include the motto.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: currency to bear the motto, IN GOD WE _____
United States one-dollar bill.fact: currency to bear the motto, IN GOD WE TRUST.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The inclusion of the motto on all currency was required by law in _____, It was added over the word ONE on the reverse
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The inclusion of the motto on all currency was required by law in 1955, It was added over the word ONE on the reverse.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Initially the BEP began printing the motto on notes printed with the new 32 note press, but soon _____ of 1935G bills printed on an 18 note press featured the motto too
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Thus all series 1957 and later notes include the motto. Initially the BEP began printing the motto on notes printed with the new 32 note press, but soon Series of 1935G bills printed on an 18 note press featured the motto too.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The reason these _____ series notes were produced into the 1960s was that older printing plates were used as long as possible
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Initially the BEP began printing the motto on notes printed with the new 32 note press, but soon Series of 1935G bills printed on an 18 note press featured the motto too. Later the 1935H series was printed only with the motto.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The final production of $1 Silver Certificates occurred in late _____
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The final production of $1 Silver Certificates occurred in late 1963. Production of one-dollar Federal Reserve Notes was undertaken in late 1963 to replace the soon-to-be obsolete $1 Silver Certificate.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Production of one-dollar Federal Reserve Notes was undertaken in late _____ to replace the soon-to-be obsolete $1 Silver Certificate
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The final production of $1 Silver Certificates occurred in late 1963. Production of one-dollar Federal Reserve Notes was undertaken in late 1963 to replace the soon-to-be obsolete $1 Silver Certificate.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: In _____, the redemption of Silver Certificates for silver coin ended and in 1968 the redemption of Silver Certificates for silver bullion ended
United States one-dollar bill.fact: In 1964, the redemption of Silver Certificates for silver coin ended and in 1968 the redemption of Silver Certificates for silver bullion ended.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The serial numbers and _____ seal were printed in green ink
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The serial numbers and Treasury seal were printed in green ink. The first change since then came in 1969, when the $1 was among all denominations of Federal Reserve Notes to feature the new Treasury seal, with English wording instead of Latin.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: This was the first time the one-dollar bill was printed as a _____
United States one-dollar bill.fact: This was the first time the one-dollar bill was printed as a Federal Reserve Note. The first change since then came in 1969, when the $1 was among all denominations of Federal Reserve Notes to feature the new Treasury seal, with English wording instead of Latin.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The first change since then came in _____, when the $1 was among all denominations of Federal Reserve Notes to feature the new Treasury seal, with English wording instead of Latin
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The first change since then came in 1969, when the $1 was among all denominations of Federal Reserve Notes to feature the new Treasury seal, with English wording instead of Latin.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The $1 bill became the first denomination printed at the new Western Currency Facility in February _____, when a shipment of 3.2 million star notes from the Dallas FRB was produced
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The $1 bill became the first denomination printed at the new Western Currency Facility in February 1991, when a shipment of 3.2 million star notes from the Dallas FRB was produced.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Though bill denominations of $5 and higher have been redesigned twice since _____ as part of ongoing anti-counterfeiting efforts, there are currently no plans to redesign the $1 or $2 bills
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Though bill denominations of $5 and higher have been redesigned twice since 1995 as part of ongoing anti-counterfeiting efforts, there are currently no plans to redesign the $1 or $2 bills.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The first experiment was conducted in _____ and February of that year to assess the effects of using different ratios of cotton to linen in the make-up of the bills
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The first experiment was conducted in January and February of that year to assess the effects of using different ratios of cotton to linen in the make-up of the bills.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: In _____, another test was conducted, similar in style to the 1933 experiment
United States one-dollar bill.fact: In 1937, another test was conducted, similar in style to the 1933 experiment.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: This test used Series _____ one-dollar bills
United States one-dollar bill.fact: This test used Series 1935 one-dollar bills.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: A better known test was done in _____ during World War II to test alternative types of paper
United States one-dollar bill.fact: A better known test was done in 1942 during World War II to test alternative types of paper.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Sometime in the early to mid-1960s, the BEP experimented with a new firm, the _____, to see if they could duplicate the usual paper production
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Sometime in the early to mid-1960s, the BEP experimented with a new firm, the Gilbert Paper Company, to see if they could duplicate the usual paper production.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The BEP selected a sequence of notes printed for the Philadelphia FRB (series _____) as the test subjects
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The BEP selected a sequence of notes printed for the Philadelphia FRB (series 1963) as the test subjects.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: In August _____, a similar experiment occurred during production of Series 1977A, when the BEP printed a few print runs on Natick paper
United States one-dollar bill.fact: In August 1981, a similar experiment occurred during production of Series 1977A, when the BEP printed a few print runs on Natick paper.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: One print run of $10 star notes, also from _____, was included in this paper test, making it so far the only experimental printing not exclusive to the $1
United States one-dollar bill.fact: They included a regular run and a star note run from the Richmond FRB, with serial numbers ranging from E76800001H through E80640000H and E07052001* through E07680000* (many sources incorrectly identify the star range as Philadelphia instead of Richmond). One print run of $10 star notes, also from Richmond, was included in this paper test, making it so far the only experimental printing not exclusive to the $1.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: One-dollar bills were again the subject of experimentation in May _____, when the BEP began to test a web-fed Intaglio printing press
United States one-dollar bill.fact: One-dollar bills were again the subject of experimentation in May 1992, when the BEP began to test a web-fed Intaglio printing press.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Because of a need for greater quantities of $1 FRNs, the BEP sent out REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP) (year _____) NO
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Because of a need for greater quantities of $1 FRNs, the BEP sent out REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP) (year 1985) NO. BEP-85-73 to procure a web-fed intaglio printing press to dramatically increase the production of currency notes within the confines of their current (1985) 14th & C street facility.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: BEP-85-73 to procure a web-fed intaglio printing press to dramatically increase the production of currency notes within the confines of their current (_____) 14th & C street facility
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Because of a need for greater quantities of $1 FRNs, the BEP sent out REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP) (year 1985) NO. BEP-85-73 to procure a web-fed intaglio printing press to dramatically increase the production of currency notes within the confines of their current (1985) 14th & C street facility.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The notes were issued in Series 1988A, _____, and 1995
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The notes were issued in Series 1988A, 1993, and 1995.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Because of mechanical problems and operator error, as well as the sometimes poor quality of the notes, production was ended in July _____
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Because of mechanical problems and operator error, as well as the sometimes poor quality of the notes, production was ended in July 1996.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Web notes can be identified by the back plate number next to IN GOD WE _____ and the removal of face check letters and quadrant numbers
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Web notes can be identified by the back plate number next to IN GOD WE TRUST and the removal of face check letters and quadrant numbers.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The oval containing _____ is propped up by bunches of bay laurel leaves
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The oval containing George Washington is propped up by bunches of bay laurel leaves. To the left of George Washington is the Federal Reserve District seal.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: To the left of _____ is the Federal Reserve District seal
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The oval containing George Washington is propped up by bunches of bay laurel leaves. To the left of George Washington is the Federal Reserve District seal.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: George Frederick Cumming Smillie, an engraver at the Bureau of Engraving and Printing, made an etching of the _____ Athenaeum Portrait by Gilbert Stuart which was used on multiple banknotes
United States one-dollar bill.fact: George Frederick Cumming Smillie, an engraver at the Bureau of Engraving and Printing, made an etching of the 1796 Athenaeum Portrait by Gilbert Stuart which was used on multiple banknotes.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: A vignette of the portrait appears on the one dollar bill of _____, and on notes since 1918
United States one-dollar bill.fact: A vignette of the portrait appears on the one dollar bill of 1899, and on notes since 1918.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The name of the _____ that issued the note encircles a capital letter (A–L), identifying it among the twelve Federal Reserve Banks
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The name of the Federal Reserve Bank that issued the note encircles a capital letter (A–L), identifying it among the twelve Federal Reserve Banks.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Until the redesign of the higher denominations of currency beginning in _____, this seal was found on all denominations of Federal Reserve notes
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Until the redesign of the higher denominations of currency beginning in 1996, this seal was found on all denominations of Federal Reserve notes.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Since then it is only present on the $1 and $2 notes, with the higher denominations only displaying a universal _____ seal, and the bank letter and number beneath the upper left serial number
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Since then it is only present on the $1 and $2 notes, with the higher denominations only displaying a universal Federal Reserve System seal, and the bank letter and number beneath the upper left serial number.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: To the right of _____ is the Treasury Department seal
United States one-dollar bill.fact: To the right of George Washington is the Treasury Department seal.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The key below the chevron represents authority and trust; _____ is the year that the Department of the Treasury was established
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The key below the chevron represents authority and trust; 1789 is the year that the Department of the Treasury was established.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The series _____ dollar bills were the first to use a simplified Treasury seal, with the wording in English instead of Latin
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The series 1969 dollar bills were the first to use a simplified Treasury seal, with the wording in English instead of Latin.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Below the FRB seal (to the left of _____) is the signature of the Treasurer of the United States, and below the USDT Seal (right side) is the Secretary of the Treasury's signature
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Below the FRB seal (to the left of George Washington) is the signature of the Treasurer of the United States, and below the USDT Seal (right side) is the Secretary of the Treasury's signature.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: To the left of the _____'s signature is the series date
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Below the FRB seal (to the left of George Washington) is the signature of the Treasurer of the United States, and below the USDT Seal (right side) is the Secretary of the Treasury's signature. To the left of the Secretary's signature is the series date.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: If "FW" appears before the lower right plate number it indicates that the bill was produced at the satellite Bureau of _____ and Printing facility in Fort Worth, Texas
United States one-dollar bill.fact: If "FW" appears before the lower right plate number it indicates that the bill was produced at the satellite Bureau of Engraving and Printing facility in Fort Worth, Texas.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Currency has been printed here since _____ 1988A
United States one-dollar bill.fact: Currency has been printed here since Series 1988A.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The absence of "FW" indicates the bill was printed at the main facility in _____, D.C
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The absence of "FW" indicates the bill was printed at the main facility in Washington, D.C. This word appears prominently in the white space at the center of the bill in a capitalized, shadowed, and seriffed typeface.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The reverse of the seal on the left features a barren landscape dominated by an unfinished pyramid of 13 steps, topped by the Eye of _____ within a triangle
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The reverse of the seal on the left features a barren landscape dominated by an unfinished pyramid of 13 steps, topped by the Eye of Providence within a triangle.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: At the base of the pyramid are engraved the Roman numerals MDCCLXXVI (_____), the year of American independence from Britain
United States one-dollar bill.fact: At the base of the pyramid are engraved the Roman numerals MDCCLXXVI (1776), the year of American independence from Britain.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The eagle's breast is covered by a heraldic shield with 13 stripes that resemble those on the _____ flag
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The eagle's breast is covered by a heraldic shield with 13 stripes that resemble those on the American flag.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: The eagle holds a ribbon in its beak reading "E PLURIBUS UNUM", a Latin phrase meaning "Out of many [states], one [nation]", a de facto motto of the United States (and the only one until _____)
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The eagle holds a ribbon in its beak reading "E PLURIBUS UNUM", a Latin phrase meaning "Out of many [states], one [nation]", a de facto motto of the United States (and the only one until 1956).

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Both the phrases "E _____" and "Annuit coeptis" contain 13 letters
United States one-dollar bill.fact: The eagle holds a ribbon in its beak reading "E PLURIBUS UNUM", a Latin phrase meaning "Out of many [states], one [nation]", a de facto motto of the United States (and the only one until 1956). Both the phrases "E Pluribus Unum" and "Annuit coeptis" contain 13 letters.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: In _____ dollar bills were produced for the Eleventh Federal Reserve District, headquartered in Dallas
United States one-dollar bill.fact: In 1963 dollar bills were produced for the Eleventh Federal Reserve District, headquartered in Dallas. Some people noticed that the 1963 Dallas note, with the number "11" and a "K" surrounded by a black seal, appeared about the time President John F. Kennedy was shot in Dallas in November 1963.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: Some people noticed that the _____ Dallas note, with the number "11" and a "K" surrounded by a black seal, appeared about the time President John F. Kennedy was shot in Dallas in November 1963
United States one-dollar bill.fact: In 1963 dollar bills were produced for the Eleventh Federal Reserve District, headquartered in Dallas. Some people noticed that the 1963 Dallas note, with the number "11" and a "K" surrounded by a black seal, appeared about the time President John F. Kennedy was shot in Dallas in November 1963.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: In _____–69 Joseph W. Barr was Secretary of the Treasury for only 31 days and his signature appeared solely on the 1963B dollar bill
United States one-dollar bill.fact: In 1968–69 Joseph W. Barr was Secretary of the Treasury for only 31 days and his signature appeared solely on the 1963B dollar bill.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: There are rumors that series _____ notes will be the last year which contains star notes, due to an update in the technology of the printing process
United States one-dollar bill.fact: There are rumors that series 2021 notes will be the last year which contains star notes, due to an update in the technology of the printing process.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: There are organizations specifically aimed at either preventing (Save the Greenback) or advocating (_____) the complete elimination of the one-dollar bill in favor of the dollar coin
United States one-dollar bill.fact: There are organizations specifically aimed at either preventing (Save the Greenback) or advocating (Coin Coalition) the complete elimination of the one-dollar bill in favor of the dollar coin.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: On November 29, _____, a House subcommittee met to consider replacing the dollar bill
United States one-dollar bill.fact: On November 29, 2012, a House subcommittee met to consider replacing the dollar bill.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: This action took place after the seventh _____ report on the subject
United States one-dollar bill.fact: This action took place after the seventh Government Accountability Office report on the subject.

United States one-dollar bill.subject: Important Days
United States one-dollar bill.question: However, according to polls, few _____ want to give up dollar bills
United States one-dollar bill.fact: However, according to polls, few Americans want to give up dollar bills.
